thread:
incident-bot: URGENT: Multiple GPU resets observed on node ded-aurum-2-07 in HelionCorp dedicated pool. Auto-drain started by controller. Paging oncall.

margo (oncall-eng): got the page, joining.

sanjay (eng-sre): oncall here, I'm seeing continuous PCIe link flaps + BMC timeouts. Node went from healthy -> degraded -> drained twice in last 12m.

trent (prod-eng): thanks — can you paste the kernel oops + nvlink logs? need to assess live user impact.

sanjay (eng-sre): quick logs below from the hostctl output:

```
[ 1123.457891] pcie 0000:3c:00.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error
[ 1123.457895] pcie 0000:3c:00.0: device_reset: reset failed
[ 1124.002314] nvidia: GPU Xid: 13, pid=4283, name=python, Xid: 13 -- PCIe link flapping
[ 1126.123456] ipmi_si: BMC is not responsive, cmd timed out
```

margo (oncall-eng): HelionCorp reports increased 503s on their VPC endpoints — approx 3% errors on traffic routed to ded-aurum-2 pool in last 10m. Elise from CSM is in thread.

elise (csm-helioncorp): confirm customer saw transient failures around 09:12 UTC, some jobs retried and queued. They're asking if their reserved capacity is affected.

trent (prod-eng): prioritize tenant isolation. If node is noisy we should evict tenants on that host and pin them to alternate reserved backends. Sanjay, what's the current eviction state?

sanjay (eng-sre): controller shows node currently in DRAINING with active evacuations: 4 pods evicted, 2 pods stuck in terminating due to stuck NVMe io. Attempting force-terminate.

margo (oncall-eng): I'll coordinate a soft isolation: apply hosttaint + isolate route so new allocs don't land. Then attempt a controlled reboot via BMC; if BMC doesn't respond we'll schedule replacement.

incident-bot: Action logged: page_ack by margo, incident_type=dedicated_pool_hardware, severity=high.

margo (oncall-eng): commands I'm running:

```
# taint node
kubectl taint nodes ded-aurum-2-07 redwood/isolated=true:NoSchedule
# force eviction
kubectl delete pod -l tenant=helioncorp --field-selector spec.nodeName=ded-aurum-2-07 --grace-period=30 --force
# power cycle via BMC
ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.11.7.207 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle
```

trent (prod-eng): careful with force delete if their checkpointing isn't completed. Elise, can you confirm which jobs are critical and need warm migration vs restart?

elise (csm-helioncorp): 2 long-running fine-tune jobs (non-checkpointing) and 3 inference endpoints; customer prefers we failover endpoints first and pause new training starts. They asked for a live runbook of steps.

sanjay (eng-sre): noted. I'm escalating to vendor: vendor-nvpro, nvlink errors + BMC unresponsive, possible firmware or PCB degradation. tagging them.

vendor-nvpro: thanks, receiving logs. Can you collect lspci -vv and bmc sel entries? We'll check ECC counters and PCIe lane errors.

margo (oncall-eng): putting customer impact on the incident doc: HelionCorp: partial degradation for reserved pool, endpoints intermittently returning 503; no total outage. ETA for mitigation 30-45m depending on hardware response.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-8472, priority=P1, owner=margo.

trent (prod-eng): while vendor triages, we should prepare a replacement host in the same AZ to keep capacity. Sanjay, can you orchestrate a hot-replace from spare node pool and migrate persistent volumes?

sanjay (eng-sre): allocating spare ded-aurum-2-13 as replacement. Plan:
  1) Ensure spare has identical GPU runtime + qcache warmup
  2) Pre-pull container images and warm KV cache
  3) Move PVs using rclone snapshot / detach-attach pattern for local NVMe-backed PVCs
  4) Shift traffic via router rule to new host when ready

margo (oncall-eng): timeline update: taint applied, 4 of 6 pods evacuated, one pod stuck on unmount. Sanjay trying force-unmount then will attempt graceful node reboot.

sanjay (eng-sre): BMC did not accept power command; getting ipmi timeouts. I'll try SOL console next.

trent (prod-eng): if SOL doesn't work, classify as 'BMC unresponsive' hardware replacement. Prepare customer comms: short note that we're isolating affected host and moving capacity to avoid impact; provide ETA ~1.5h for full replacement.

elise (csm-helioncorp): customer asked for a temporary SLA credit if sustained errors exceed 5% in the next 24h. I've noted and raised to account ops.

margo (oncall-eng): handoff in 30 minutes to night crew if not resolved. @trent @sanjay please capture exact commands and status in the incident doc for continuity.

incident-bot: Note: scheduled on-call handoff at 2026-03-15T22:00Z to night-sre.

vendor-nvpro: BMC SEL entries indicate repeated I2C timeouts and a PSU rail glitch at 09:08 UTC. Recommending board-level swap. We can ship FRU to datacenter; ETA 3h for field tech.

sanjay (eng-sre): given field ETA, we will continue to evacuate tenants from the node and put it into quarantine; provisioning replacement node now.

margo (oncall-eng): executing final step to mark node quarantined and remove from scheduler pool.

```
# quarantine tag
kubectl label node ded-aurum-2-07 redwood/quarantine=hardware-issue
kubectl cordon ded-aurum-2-07
```

margo (oncall-eng): final customer update posted to HelionCorp slack and email: we've isolated the noisy host, moved inference endpoints to alternate reserved capacity, training jobs paused/queued, replacement in progress. We'll share postmortem and any credits after root cause.

elise (csm-helioncorp): acknowledged, customer appreciates the proactive shift.

trent (prod-eng): follow-ups: collect full dmesg, nv-hostengine logs, BMC console dump, and add to INC-20260315-8472. Add tag for regression evals against model-serving QA prompts.

sanjay (eng-sre): logs collected and uploaded to incident bucket: s3://incidents/INC-20260315-8472/logs/ded-aurum-2-07.tar.gz

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-8472 updated: state=mitigating, assigned=margo, sla_impacted=true.

margo (oncall-eng): handing off to @night-sre in 30m — leave node quarantined, replacement node in warm standby, vendor FRU en route. If anything regresses escalate to oncall product-engineer.

night-sre (via thread note): acknowledged, will monitor and continue tenant migration if needed. :eyes:

trent (prod-eng): thanks team. Postmortem owner: trent. Action items: FRU swap verification, automate BMC health alerting, improve NVMe unmount timeout handling in evac flow.

incident-bot: Incident closed? (manual) — awaiting postmortem.
